decisions.decision: Select Board deferred its recommendation on Article 3 (Payment of Prior Year Bills) to the pre-Town Meeting session the next evening, so the Town Manager could verify revised capital-balance figures.
decisions.quote: the select board concurred and article 3 was deferred without a vote.

budget_items.topic: Article 2 supplemental appropriation to Town Accountant budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager presented a proposed supplemental appropriation of $160,052, revised up from $150,000, and said it may not be enough to cover transitional services through year-end.
budget_items.quote: presented a detailed breakdown of the proposed $160,052 supplemental appropriation to the town accountant budget, revised upward from the $150,000 figure

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $12,181 salary supplement was needed to bring the Town Accountant salary line to $145,000, after a planned salary reserve transfer brought it only to $135,000.
budget_items.quote: town accountant salary supplement ($12,181): the position salary line required a supplement to bring the budgeted amount to $145,000

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY26 budget allocated $40,000 for audit services; a proposed three-year CliftonLarsonAllen agreement puts the FY 2025 audit at $60,000, with a $20,000 supplemental and $3,500 prior-year balance.
budget_items.quote: audit costs ($20,000 supplemental + $3,500 prior year balance): the fy26 budget had allocated $40,000 for audit services.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Contracted services of $107,000, the largest component of Article 2, covered accounts payable support, a payroll and benefits specialist, and transitional Finance Director services.
budget_items.quote: contracted services ($107,000): this represented the largest component, broken down as follows: accounts payable support at 22 hours per week through the end of december ($15,730)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The not-to-exceed amendment for the transitional consultant rose from $10,000 to $50,000; billing was running about $175 per hour and expected to rise with year-end work.
budget_items.quote: transitional finance director services with consultant eric kinsherf, with a not-to-exceed contract amendment from $10,000 to $50,000.

budget_items.topic: Town revenue surplus available for appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported a total revenue surplus available for appropriation of $195,790.97; if Articles 2 and 3 both passed, remaining additional levy capacity would be $35,321.75.
budget_items.quote: noting a total revenue surplus available for appropriation of $195,790.97, derived from positive changes to the cherry sheet

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $27,500 transfer appropriated at May Town Meeting for a special project was proposed to move to Assessors Administration for an internal approach to an assessors' project; the funds would stay unspent if the special assessor position article failed.
budget_items.quote: a final transfer of $27,500 appropriated at may town meeting for a special project was

budget_items.quote: heywood hospital ($266): a small prior year bill for physicals, to be paid from the fy26 budget.

budget_items.topic: Article 3 prior-year bill: CliftonLarsonAllen FY24 audit balance
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $3,500 outstanding FY24 audit balance, to be paid from the adjusted FY 2026 Town Accountant line.
budget_items.quote: cliftonlarsonallen ($3,500): an outstanding balance on the fy24 audit, to be paid from the adjusted fy 2026 town accountant line as modified by article 2.

budget_items.quote: advanced print technology ($390): a prior year invoice for t-shirts, to be paid from the fy26 budget.

budget_items.topic: Article 3 prior-year obligation: City of Fitchburg water agreement
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A newly identified $90,000 prior-year obligation under a 1993 water agreement; Fitchburg charges 14% annual interest on late payments after 30 days, which accounts for much of the amount owed. Funding proposed from prior-year capital balances and raise-and-appropriate; Article 3 was deferred.
budget_items.quote: city of fitchburg ($90,000): a newly identified and substantial prior year obligation arising from the town's 1993 intermunicipal water agreement

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY26 budget allocated only $45,000 for the water billing function, a figure the Finance Director said appeared set without rigorous analysis and would likely need adjustment at a future Annual Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: the fy26 budget had allocated only $45,000 for this purpose, a figure that appeared to have been set without rigorous analysis

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A mathematical discrepancy in committed capital balances meant the raise-and-appropriate portion had to rise by about $4,170, with a matching reduction to the transfer from Article 5 of the May 2024 Annual Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: a need to increase the raise-and-appropriate portion by approximately $4,170, with a corresponding reduction to the transfer from article 5
